title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. translated_title: BitMTP：当多词元预测遇上低比特大语言模型
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.28500v1，公告类型：cross）：为了实现大语言模型（LLM）的高效部署，超低比特骨干网络方法可以降低权重存储、内存流量和线性层执行成本，而多词元预测（MTP）方法通过并行预测多个未来词元来减少顺序解码步骤。尽管这两种方法互补，但直接结合它们无法在同等质量下加速解码：掩码草稿生成缺少下一个词元训练中所提供的中间词元输入，同时更宽的计算和因果键值（KV）更新可能会抵消更少解码步骤带来的节省。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出BitMTP，一个用于在超低比特LLM骨干网络上实现高效MTP的算法-系统协同设计框架。通过联合下一个词元预测与MTP的训练目标，单个模型同时具备自回归（AR）生成和块因果草稿生成能力。仅置信度解码、仅投机解码和混合解码提供了不同的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出BitMTP算法-系统协同设计框架，将多词元预测与超低比特大语言模型骨干相结合，使单一模型兼具自回归生成与块因果草稿生成能力，在保持同等生成质量的前提下实现高效解码加速。
en_tdlr: BitMTP is an algorithm-system co-design framework that combines multi-token prediction with ultra-low-bit LLM backbones, enabling a single model with both autoregressive generation and block-causal drafting to achieve efficient decoding acceleration at comparable quality.
